column1: # EGRG protocol B video side: fixed-epoch SUBJECT-DISJOINT folds for the TT-X3D video grader
# (grader/train_grader.py --split subject --fold k; split_subjects seed 49 = the same 4 animals per
# fold as the EEG folds, verified by grader/eeg/check_folds.py). One seed, dual heads (g3 + g5), two
# recipes: x3dbug = no --fix_x3d (historical head softmax; the historically best 3-class X3D) and
# x3dfix = --fix_x3d. 12 epochs, lr 1e-4, batch 8 (fixed by the driver), per-epoch val_ep*.npz,
# LAST epoch reported. NOT SUBMITTED.
# Driver: the existing grader/sbatch_grader.sh (10 lines -> --array=0-9). Preview / submit with
#   bash grader/eeg/submit_eeg.sh video               (DRY RUN by default)
#   DRY_RUN=0 bash grader/eeg/submit_eeg.sh video     (really submits, via grader/submit_ttg.sh stage1)
# CAUTION: calling grader/submit_ttg.sh directly SUBMITS by default (its DRY_RUN defaults to 0).
# joint_gate.py reads them as templates output/ttg_vsubj/x3dbug_dual_s1_fold{f} / x3dfix_dual_s1_fold{f}.
